# Docker: 10-Session Course

Containerize a real app, run a multi-service stack, ship from CI, deploy to a VPS.

## 1. The container mental model

notes.md explaining image vs container, plus nginx served from a container

## 2. Images, layers, and the CLI you'll actually use

A personal docker-cheatsheet.md written in your own words

## 3. Your first Dockerfile

A committed Dockerfile for a working API, plus why package.json is copied first

## 4. Containerizing React and Next.js

Your capstone frontend running in both a dev and a prod container

## 5. Multi-stage builds and image optimization

A before/after size table and a production image under your size budget

## 6. Data: volumes, bind mounts, and persistence

A database container with a persistence proof (data survives docker rm)

## 7. Networking and Docker Compose

Your whole capstone stack starting with one docker compose up

## 8. Configuration, environments, and secrets

A dev/prod configuration split and a note on where secrets live at each stage

## 9. Docker in CI/CD with GitHub Actions

A green workflow that builds, tests, scans, and pushes a tagged image

## 10. Running containers in production

A live URL serving your containerized app, plus a README on the architecture
